name: Unknown Operations : The Habitus
detailed_description:
Unknown Operations: The Habitus

is a story-driven, single-player, first-person tactical shooter set during World War II. In the game, you take on the role of Eduard Pěnkava, a soldier and later an agent of the secret organization Habitus, fighting not only against the Nazis but also for the safety of his loved ones and higher ideals. The story combines fictional and historical characters and events to create an intense and captivating experience.

The game is developed on Unreal Engine 5, delivering high visual quality and a seamless gameplay experience. With planned updates, the game will adapt to the latest versions of this advanced engine, ensuring players have access to the best possible technological advancements.

Key Features:

  • Historical Inspiration: Missions are inspired by real events, such as the Battle of Czajankova Barracks or the Operation of the Three Kings. The game features accurate models of weapons and certain vehicles from World War II.

  • Vehicle and Static Weapon Control: Take the wheel of tanks, trucks, or cars, or operate heavy machine guns and cannons to turn the tide of battle.

  • Compelling Story: A narrative filled with espionage, sabotage, and moral dilemmas, told retrospectively from an interrogation room of the secret police.

  • Intense Gameplay: Destroy enemy bases, adapt to changing environments, and strategize on the battlefield with realistic ballistics and destructible environments.

  • NPC Interaction: Engage with characters through a dialogue system and uncover key information that influences the story's progression.

  • Advanced AI: NPCs dynamically respond to situations using the Utility AI system, adding realism to the gameplay.

  • Dynamic Environment: Experience changing weather, day-night cycles, and interactive environmental elements that immerse you in the war atmosphere.

Historical Authenticity:

The game emphasizes the accuracy of weapons and certain vehicles, but due to the constraints faced by a solo developer, not all building models and clothing are fully historically accurate. Nevertheless, the game strives to convey an authentic sense of the wartime conflict and its atmosphere.

Story:

The protagonist, Eduard Pěnkava, begins his journey as a young soldier who soon becomes entangled in events that go beyond ordinary wartime conflicts. From the defense of Czajankova Barracks to sabotage missions targeting secret German projects, Pěnkava becomes a key figure in the secret organization Habitus. Along his path, he encounters love, betrayal, and moral dilemmas, with every decision shaping the course of the war.

Featuring dynamic environments, vehicle control, advanced AI, and a gripping narrative inspired by real events. Developed on UE5

content_descriptors.notes:
Unknown Operations: The Habitus features realistic depictions of violence associated with wartime conflicts, including gunfights, explosions, and injuries. The game also includes scenes that may be emotionally challenging, such as the death of close characters.

The game does not contain sexual content or themes such as rape or non-consensual sex. Additionally, excessive drug or alcohol use and self-harm are not present. However, certain gameplay situations and decisions may present moral dilemmas that could be emotionally challenging for some players.
